description: Extracts structured cannabis legality information from country profile pages on www.cannabisregulations.ai, including legal status, governing bodies, regulations, and import/export rules.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_country_legality: Fetch comprehensive cannabis legality data for a country (requires country or url); 参数: country, url; 必填: 无
  - extract_legal_status: Get just the legal status and summary for a country (requires country or url); 参数: country, url; 必填: 无

country.description: Country name to look up (e.g., "Ecuador", "Kazakhstan", "Antigua and Barbuda"). Used by get_country_legality and extract_legal_status.

url.description: Full URL to the country legality page on cannabisregulations.ai. Optional; will be constructed from country name if not provided.
